description.value: You're well-versed in the street racing technique known as drifting, or sliding your vehicle through the entirety of a curve while maintaining speed and showcasing your driving skills. While piloting a land vehicle, when you perform Piloting actions with the reckless trait, your vehicle only becomes uncontrolled on a critical failure. On a failure, the vehicle moves as described under reckless piloting, except that you, not the GM, control where the vehicle drifts. You can choose to fail (but not critically fail) a reckless Piloting action. The GM, however, has discretion as to when a vehicle you're piloting is too large or unwieldy for this technique to be viable—it's a move that works with sports hovercars and not long-hauler transports (generally).
